source: Seven user-provided screenshots selected for the final report

images.title: Tournament directory
images.caption: Figure 1 Tournament directory. Lists events with their status, player count, prize and organizer, and provides an Open button to load a selected tournament.

images.title: Registered player view
images.caption: Figure 2 Tournament details. Shows the connected account's role, event rules, participant information, deadlines and individual ETH prize and LRT bonus credits.

images.title: Tournament actions
images.caption: Figure 3 Tournament actions. Provides registration opening, player entry, roster locking, result finalization, prize withdrawal, fee refunds, organizer prize recovery and cancellation. Each action is checked against its role and lifecycle conditions.

images.title: LRT exchange
images.caption: Figure 4 LRT exchange. Provides token inventory contribution, LRT purchase, approved token redemption and withdrawal of credited redemption ETH. The interface also displays the user's redemption credit.

images.title: Tournament creation
images.caption: Figure 5 Tournament creation. Lets an organizer set the referee and resolver, ETH prize, optional LRT bonus, entry fee, capacity, ranked shares and time windows. Creation escrows the ETH prize; registration opening transfers the optional LRT bonus.

images.title: Results and arbitration
images.caption: Figure 6 Results and arbitration. Lets the referee submit ranked winners and evidence, the resolver review a dispute and confirm or correct the ranking, and a participant raise an objection. Evidence text is hashed in the browser for the on-chain commitment.

images.title: Transaction activity
images.caption: Figure 7 Transaction activity. Displays project transaction history for the connected account, including earlier sessions, with links to inspect individual transactions on Sepolia Etherscan.
